headline: Sensex Nears 82,000 and Nifty Hits 8-Month High Amid Strong Q2 Results and Foreign Flow Optimism

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism over foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows
Strong Q2 corporate earnings results from major companies
Decline in global oil prices boosting market sentiment
Moody's upward revision of India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7%
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,300 points, approaching the 82,000 milestone
Nifty 50 jumped above 25,350, reaching an 8-month high
Investors added approximately ₹35 lakh crore to market capitalization over seven sessions
Financial and automobile sectors led the broad market rally
summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied significantly with the Sensex nearing 82,000 and Nifty hitting an 8-month high, driven by robust Q2 earnings and lower oil prices. Tata Power and Hindustan Copper reported strong profit growth, while Moody's raised India's GDP growth estimate. Market capitalization saw a massive increase of ₹35 lakh crore over the last seven trading sessions.
